---
title: "scRNA Quality Control"
format: html
execute:
  warning: false
  message: false
---

## Purpose

Filter low-quality cells, flag QC metrics, and save the filtered Seurat object.

## Packages

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-02-quality-control-packages
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Load only the packages used in this template.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(Seurat)
  library(qs2)
  library(readr)
  library(dplyr)
})
```

## User Config

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-02-quality-control-user-config
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# USER INPUT:
input_object <- "path/to/seurat_created.qs"
output_object <- "path/to/seurat_qc.qs"
results_dir <- "results/scrna_qc"
figures_dir <- "figures/scrna_qc"
assay_name <- "RNA"
sample_column <- "sample_column"
group_column <- "group_column"
min_features <- 200
max_features <- Inf
max_percent_mito <- 20
seed <- 1
n_threads <- 4
compress_level <- 6
```

## Input Loading

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-02-quality-control-input-loading
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Create output folders and load configured inputs.
set.seed(seed)
dir.create(results_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
dir.create(figures_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)
object <- qs2::qs_read(file = input_object, nthreads = n_threads)
DefaultAssay(object) <- assay_name
```

## Validation

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-02-quality-control-validation
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Stop early when required inputs or columns are missing.
stopifnot(inherits(object, "Seurat"))
stopifnot(sample_column %in% colnames(object[[]]), group_column %in% colnames(object[[]]))
if (!"percent_mito" %in% colnames(object[[]])) object[["percent_mito"]] <- PercentageFeatureSet(object, pattern = "^MT-")
```

## Input Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-02-quality-control-input-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Write a small TSV summary of the loaded input.
before_tbl <- tibble::tibble(cells_before = ncol(object), features = nrow(object))
readr::write_tsv(before_tbl, file.path(results_dir, "qc_input_summary.tsv"))
before_tbl
```

## Main Analysis

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-02-quality-control-main-analysis
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Run the reusable analysis step for this template.
object$qc_pass <- object$nFeature_RNA >= min_features &
  object$nFeature_RNA <= max_features &
  object$percent_mito <= max_percent_mito
filtered <- subset(object, subset = qc_pass)
```

## QC Checks

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-02-quality-control-qc-checks
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export checks that make failures easy to inspect.
qc_tbl <- object[[]] |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id")
readr::write_tsv(qc_tbl, file.path(results_dir, "qc_all_cells.tsv"))
readr::write_tsv(filtered[[]] |> tibble::rownames_to_column("cell_id"), file.path(results_dir, "qc_pass_cells.tsv"))
```

## Visualization

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-02-quality-control-visualization
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save compact figures for the main outputs.
pdf(file.path(figures_dir, "scrna_qc_violin.pdf"), width = 8, height = 4)
print(VlnPlot(object, features = c("nFeature_RNA", "nCount_RNA", "percent_mito"), group.by = sample_column, pt.size = 0))
dev.off()
```

## Object Result Storage

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-02-quality-control-object-result-storage
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Store reusable analysis metadata inside the object.
filtered@misc$template <- list(step = "scrna_quality_control", thresholds = list(min_features = min_features, max_features = max_features, max_percent_mito = max_percent_mito))
```

## Result Export

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-02-quality-control-result-export
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Export the main reusable tables as TSV files.
readr::write_tsv(tibble::tibble(cells_after = ncol(filtered), cells_removed = ncol(object) - ncol(filtered)), file.path(results_dir, "qc_summary.tsv"))
```

## Final Save

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-02-quality-control-final-save
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Save the updated object for the next template step.
object <- filtered
qs2::qs_save(object, file = output_object, nthreads = n_threads, compress_level = compress_level)
```

## Output Summary

```{r}
#| label: tpl-scrna-02-quality-control-output-summary
#| echo: true
#| warning: false
#| message: false
# Print a compact summary of generated outputs.
tibble::tibble(output_object = output_object, cells = ncol(object), features = nrow(object))
```
